content: Vietnam 2026 public holidays: New Year Jan 1-2; Tet (Lunar New Year) 9 consecutive days Feb 14-22; Hung Kings Day Apr 26 (+make-up Apr 27); Reunification Day Apr 30 + Labor Day May 1 (4 consecutive days with weekend); National Day Sep 2; new Vietnam Culture Day Nov 24 (added starting 2026, brings total to ~12 holiday days across fewer distinct occasions). Holidays falling on weekend get a compensatory weekday off.
